 How to watch Heat vs Warriors
 Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026
 Time: 10:00 PM ET
 Channel: NBA TV, NBC Sports Bay Area
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Miami has struggled to find consistency early in the 2026-27 season, entering Thursday's contest with a 2-5 record. Giannis Antetokounmpo has been the driving force behind the Heat's offense, averaging 28.4 points and 12.3 rebounds per game. Miami has shown its offensive potential with impressive victories over the Atlanta Hawks and Indiana Pacers, but defensive struggles have prevented the team from building momentum. The Heat will need a strong performance on both ends of the floor to challenge a red-hot Golden State squad.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Warriors have won five consecutive games, improving to 5-3 after defeating the Phoenix Suns 116-113 on Monday. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg has emerged as an exciting contributor, scoring a career-high 37 points against the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday. Golden State has also been shooting exceptionally well from beyond the arc, connecting on nearly 39% of its three-point attempts this season. Thursday's game tips off at 10:00 PM ET on NBA TV.
